title: Technical Anchor
jobDescription:
As a Technical Anchor, you will play a pivotal role in Ford’s digital transformation by bridging cutting-edge AI technologies with robust full-stack engineering. You will lead a cross-functional product team in designing, developing, and delivering high-quality software using a modern technology stack, including React, Java/Spring Boot, and Dialog Flow. This role is inherently dual in nature—combining deep expertise in Conversational AI with strong full-stack architectural capabilities. You will craft intuitive, human-like conversational experiences using advanced NLP and LLM frameworks, while ensuring that the underlying systems are scalable, secure, and built on cloud-native principles. In addition, you will champion a culture of Software Craftsmanship by mentoring engineers in best practices such as Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Pair Programming. You will actively explore emerging AI trends and contribute to shaping enterprise-wide technology strategies and innovations. Technical Leadership: Drive the end-to-end design, development, and delivery of Conversational AI and full-stack solutions across web and mobile platforms. AI Architecture: Design and implement sophisticated multi-turn conversational flows, oversee NLU/LLM frameworks, and guide the fine-tuning, optimization, and deployment of AI models. Software Craftsmanship: Foster a culture of Agile and Extreme Programming (XP) practices, promoting excellence through Pair Programming, Test-Driven Development (TDD), and resilient CI/CD pipelines. Full-Stack Development: Build and scale modern front-end applications using React and develop robust back-end microservices with Java/Spring Boot, leveraging cloud-native architectures. Strategic Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to define product vision, prioritize high-impact deliverables, and explore emerging AI trends to drive innovation. Basic Qualifications

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) or Computer Applications (M.C.A.). Experience: Minimum of 10+ years of hands-on experience in software development, with a proven track record in technical leadership. Back-End Development: At least 4+ years of experience working with the Spring ecosystem, including Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Spring Cloud. Front-End Development: 4+ years of experience with React, along with 3+ years of exposure to additional frameworks such as Angular or technologies like Graph QL. Cloud & API Development: 3+ years of experience building microservices-based architectures (REST/SOAP) and 2+ years of experience in cloud-native development using platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure. Preferred Qualifications AI/ML Expertise: Hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) such as Open AI, Gemini, or LLa MA, including model development, fine-tuning, and deployment. Frameworks & Tools: Proficiency in NLP and deep learning frameworks such as Tensor Flow, Py Torch, Hugging Face, or spa Cy. Conversational AI Platforms: Practical experience with platforms like Dialog Flow, Amazon Lex, or Microsoft Bot Framework. Voice Technologies: Familiarity with Speech-to-Text (STT), Text-to-Speech (TTS), and telephony system integrations. Engineering & Agile Tooling: Strong expertise in CI/CD tools (Git Hub, Jenkins), testing frameworks (JUnit, Selenium), and monitoring tools (Splunk, Dynatrace). Certifications: Relevant certifications in Conversational AI, NLP, or cloud AI platforms (e.g., Google Cloud AI) are highly desirable.

title: Salesforce Solution Architect - IMG CRM
jobDescription: Description We are seeking a highly experienced Salesforce Solution Architect to lead CRM architecture across our International Markets business, including Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, and South East Asia. In this role, you will define architecture strategy, guide technology investments, and partner with business and technology leaders to deliver scalable Salesforce solutions. This is a high-impact individual contributor position with significant visibility across business and technology organizations. The successful candidate will help shape both regional and global CRM architecture roadmaps while driving modernization and innovation initiatives. Responsibilities Define and govern CRM architecture strategy across Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and related technologies. Develop architecture blueprints, capability maps, roadmaps, and solution recommendations aligned with enterprise technology strategy. Lead greenfield solution architecture initiatives and legacy CRM modernization programs. Partner with business stakeholders, product teams, and technology leaders to translate business objectives into scalable solutions. Influence architectural decisions through clear business and technical communication. Ensure solutions balance business value, scalability, maintainability, security, and cost. Contribute to enterprise architecture standards, reference architectures, and governance processes. Collaborate with integration, cloud, data, and security teams to deliver end-to-end solutions. Stay current with Salesforce innovation, CRM industry trends, AI capabilities, and emerging technologies. Support global collaboration and occasional international engagements when required. Qualifications Required Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field. 8+ years of experience in enterprise technology, CRM platforms, or solution architecture. Salesforce architecture experience across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, or related Salesforce products. Salesforce Certified Application Architect credential or equivalent architecture expertise. Strong understanding of CRM business processes within Sales and Service organizations. Experience creating architecture strategies, technology roadmaps, and enterprise solution blueprints. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influence skills. Preferred Salesforce Certified System Architect. Marketing Cloud certifications. Mule Soft architecture certifications. Experience with CRM modernization and legacy transformation programs. Experience in automotive, dealer systems, or customer lifecycle platforms. Knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP), integration architecture, and data architecture. Experience with TOGAF or comparable enterprise architecture frameworks. Familiarity with Salesforce Data Cloud, AI, and Agentforce capabilities.

title: Director, Material/Vehicle Logistics & Customs IT
jobDescription: Ford is in the middle of Supply Chain Transformation. One of the key focus areas to enable this transformation is optimized planning & execution of our logistics network, along with proactive management of customs/duty/tariff regulations, to drive supply assurance in support of demand for our world-leading products. Ford is seeking an experienced, strategic, and hands-on Director – Material/Vehicle Logistics & Customs IT . In this critical role, you will own the end-to-end strategy, delivery, implementation, and maintenance of the digital products powering Ford’s global supply chain. This role will help drive the solutions for inbound material logistics, finished vehicle logistics, “intralogistics” of parts/vehicles across Ford facilities and customs compliance. Functionally, this includes network planning, transportation management, end-to-end visibility, yard/compound logistics, global trade compliance and integration with warehouse management capabilities. Specifically, this role will Be the global Enterprise Technology face off for Inbound materials, finished vehicle distribution & customs compliance business functions Be accountable for technical and operational excellence of portfolio, delivery of IT investments, and production support. Own and manage delivery of IT investments: governance, budgets, contracts, reviews, feasibility, cost benefit analysis, prioritization, initiation, execution, and closure. Develop strategy and explore future technologies powering material and vehicle logistics transformation Adopt an AI-First mindset and leading cloud offerings to modernize the portfolio (replacing legacy/ mainframe technologies) and innovate extensively to solve business problems Drive technical integration of portfolio and ensure seamless interoperability across ecosystem to provide best in class user experience. What you’ll be able to do: Define and evangelize the multi-year product roadmap for Ford's global logistics and trade compliance platforms, aligning closely with Material Planning & Logistics (MP&L) and plant operations Guide product and integration teams across full lifecycle of a diverse application portfolio driving transportation network planning, multi-modal visibility of materials and vehicles, distribution, yard/compound management, trade compliance and other associated core supply chain execution functions Lead, mentor, and coach a global team of product managers and engineers, fostering a culture of agile excellence and continuous improvement. Optimize resource footprint to take advantage of talents globally and across Ford and technology partners Ensure delivery is managed effectively using Agile delivery and portfolio management practices. Drive the migration of legacy mainframe and on-premise systems to modern, scalable cloud environments (e.g., Google Cloud Platform) and industry-leading Saa S/COTS platforms. Partner with legal and trade compliance teams to ensure systems meet strict global import/export standards, tariff classifications, and trade agreements (e.g., USMCA). Apply a broad understanding of Ford enterprise architecture and technology standards to guide solutions/services Work together effectively with senior management, business partners, suppliers and internal IT partners, ensuring high availability, security, and performance of mission-critical logistics systems Ensure that financial targets are met for operating budget and new investments. Lead, mentor, and coach a global team of product managers and engineers, fostering a culture of agile excellence and continuous improvement Minimum Requirements we seek: Bachelors’ degree in Computer Science, Supply Chain Management or Information Systems or relevant experience At least 10 years of progressive responsibilities within technology and software functions Direct experience managing or implementing IT systems in at least two of the following areas: Inbound Material Logistics (transportation mgmt., yard mgmt. control tower). Outbound/Finished Vehicle Logistics (transportation mgmt., yard mgmt., damage mgmt.) Customs Compliance & Global Trade (import/export clearance, duty drawback, classification, solicitation). Strong vendor management skills to engage with Saa S platform as well as services providers Hands-on experience in multiple roles across the spectrum of the lifecycle of applications and/or technologies. Demonstrated experience of having delivered AI-enabled solutions with cloud-native technologies, including ability to implement AI tooling at every phase of software development lifecycle with a large team of engineers. Familiarity with cloud architectures (Google Cloud Platform preferred), API-driven integrations. Exposure Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. Knowledge of tracking technologies like RFID, BLE, GPS, or Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) in a logistics environment will be a plus. Other expected experiences: Enterprise Technology Partner Management Ability to interact extensively with and influence senior business leaders, technology partners and software platform & services providers. Implementation experience with multiple delivery models – including supplier-led engagements, Saa S solutions, strong supplier management skills and effective contract-negotiation skills. Communication Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with all levels of management in varying areas of business and enterprise technology Strong interpersonal skills, demonstrating professionalism in all actions. Functional & Technical Experience with global team development and building knowledge and capability. Management skills/experience and independent, decision-making skills. Develop and maintain strong knowledge of the business functional areas for Supply Chain, including logistics Technical excellence in software design, development, and deployment. Program/Project Management Demonstrated ability to deliver on project commitments through leadership, rigorous execution, teamwork, strategic planning/scheduling, problem analysis, resolution, and productivity improvements. Agile delivery methodologies and Product Driven Organization implementation. Manage portfolio level financials & budgets and guide regular financial reporting for the portfolio and major development projects

title: Senior Software Engineer- Platform & DevEx
jobDescription:
This role sits at the intersection of software development and platform engineering, bringing a developer-first mindset to the platform team. You will design and build APIs, automation, and developer portal integrations that enable self-service capabilities and enhance the developer experience for engineering teams running workloads on GKE. Working closely with application teams, you will help drive platform adoption by delivering scalable, reliable, and intuitive platform capabilities. This role provides an excellent opportunity for a hands-on backend engineer to grow into platform engineering, gaining expertise in Git Ops , Kubernetes, service mesh, custom controllers (Go), multi-cluster operations, and production-grade platform development. You will receive mentorship and hands-on support from experienced platform engineers while progressively taking ownership of increasingly complex infrastructure and platform initiatives. WHAT YOU WILL DO Design and build backend APIs (REST / Open API ) to provision and manage GKE namespaces and clusters
- with Swagger-testable contracts, secured via OAuth2 / JWT. Develop platform automation: custom Kubernetes controllers and operators in Go, and/or backend microservices in Java / Spring Boot (or Node.js), to automate, environment lifecycle, and platform workflows on GKE. Integrate APIs with our internal developer portal (Red Hat Developer Hub / Backstage): software templates, scaffolder actions, and backend plugins so developers can self-serve namespaces and applications. Publish and secure APIs through an API gateway (e.g. Apigee) with SSO / OAuth2 / JWT token validation and integrate with our platform API/asset layer. Onboard and support application teams: help them bring their applications and microservices onto the GKE platform
- deployment manifests, Helm charts, CI/CD, observability, service mesh, and connectivity, and act as their trusted partner during migration. Act as the voice of the developer: use your own hands-on development background to identify developer pain points and shape the platform's paved road so onboarding is genuinely frictionless. Build and maintain Kubernetes deployment artifacts (Deployments, Replica Sets , Services, Config Maps , Secrets, Ingress/ HTTPRoute ) and Helm charts for platform and application workloads. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines (Git Hub Actions), container image build/publish, and artifact management for repeatable releases. Instrument services and build dashboards/alerts in Dynatrace; help app teams onboard to observability. Work within a service-mesh environment (Cloud Service Mesh / Istio)
- secure service-to-service communication ( m TLS ), traffic management, and resilient inter-service calls. Participate in the platform on-call rotation
- production support, incident response, root-cause analysis, and follow-up remediation. Contribute to our agentic AI initiative
- helping expose platform APIs as MCP servers and integrate them with Gemini Enterprise so developers can onboard services, wire observability, and provision resources through natural-language, AI-assisted workflows. Collaborate with platform, security, and application teams; write clear documentation; and mentor where appropriate. Overall Experience: 8–10 years Relevant Experience: 4–6 years (backend development, APIs, Kubernetes, Git Ops , AWS or GCP) Core Languages: Java / Spring Boot, or Node.js, or Go (Golang) REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE Hands-on development background: Strong experience as a working software developer
- in Java / Spring Boot, Node.js, or Go
- so you understand developer workflows and pain points first-hand. Backend & microservices: Building production microservices and secure REST APIs; Spring Boot / Spring Cloud (or equivalent in Node.js / Go). API & integration: Open API /Swagger, API integration between microservices and backend systems, API gateways, and authentication with OAuth2, JWT tokens, and SSO. Kubernetes: Authoring deployment manifests (Deployments, Replica Sets , Services, Config Maps , Secrets) and deploying microservices to managed clusters (GKE/EKS); Docker, Helm. Automation mindset: Experience automating platform or infrastructure workflows through code
- custom controllers/operators (Go) or backend services (Java/Node.js). Git Ops & CI/CD: Argo CD ( Git Ops ) for application delivery; CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins / Git Hub Actions), container image build/push, artifact repositories. Developer enablement: Experience onboarding or supporting application teams
- helping them deploy, troubleshoot, and operate their services on a shared platform. Observability & support: Dynatrace (or similar)
- dashboards, log monitoring, instrumentation; production support and on-call incident handling. Cloud: Working knowledge of a major cloud (GCP and/or AWS); IAM, service accounts, and Workload Identity concepts. Ways of working: Agile delivery, ownership from design to production support, collaboration, and clear communication. NICE TO HAVE / WILLINGNESS TO LEARN Go (Golang) for custom controllers: Experience with or strong interest in learning
- Go and Kubebuilder / controller-runtime for building custom Kubernetes controllers and operators. Type Script / Node.js: Understanding of Type Script and Node.js for building Red Hat Developer Hub (Backstage) plugins and scaffolder actions or strong willingness to ramp quickly. Experience with Red Hat Developer Hub / Backstage, or other internal developer portals / software templates. Service mesh (Cloud Service Mesh / Istio) : m TLS , traffic management, multi-cluster service discovery. GKE Fleet / Connect Gateway, Workload Identity, GKE networking (Gateway API, internal load balancing, DNS). Agentic AI & MCP: Interest in or experience with building agentic AI capabilities on the platform: exposing GKE platform APIs as MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and integrating them with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform to enable AI-assisted developer self-service. Cloud certifications (e.g. Google Cloud / AWS Solutions Architect or Developer Associate). AI-assisted development tooling (Git Hub Copilot, Cursor) and prompt-engineering practices.

title: Buyer – Exterior Commodities (Glass & Mirror)
jobDescription: This role supports post‑commercial purchasing activities from contract sign‑off through end of production. Operational Purchasing Manage operational purchasing activities for exterior commodities including Glass, Mirror, and related plastic components. Place Purchase Orders / Transfer Orders accurately and on time. Support purchasing activities from commercial agreement sign‑off through End of Production (EOP). Strong experience handling exterior commodities such as Glass, Mirror, and plastic parts. Prior experience in an OEM automotive environment is required. Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and negotiation skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Good understanding of supply chain and vendor development processes. Willingness to work in a late evening shift (2:00 PM – 11:30 PM IST) to support North America stakeholders. We encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds.

title: Process Engineer - Powertrain Assembly
jobDescription:
The Process Engineer
- Powertrain Assembly will support the design, development, launch, and continuous improvement of engine and transmission assembly processes. The role requires strong technical knowledge of manufacturing systems, automation, quality tools, and lean manufacturing principles to deliver safe, efficient, and high-quality production operations. Process Design & Development Develop and optimise engine and transmission assembly processes for new and existing programs. Design manufacturing process flows, workstation layouts, and assembly line configurations. Create and maintain process documentation, including work instructions and standard operating procedures. Support product launches, engineering changes, and process improvements. Equipment & Tooling Define requirements for assembly equipment, fixtures, tooling, and automation systems. Coordinate equipment design reviews, installation activities, and commissioning with suppliers. Validate equipment performance and ensure compliance with safety, quality, and ergonomic standards. Quality & Continuous Improvement Investigate manufacturing issues using structured problem-solving methodologies and root cause analysis. Implement corrective and preventive actions to improve process stability and product quality. Support Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA), control plans, and error-proofing initiatives. Drive Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and Kaizen projects to improve productivity, reduce waste, and optimise cycle time. Capacity Planning & Cost Management Support capital investment planning and cost estimation activities. Conduct line balancing, capacity analysis, and takt time studies. Evaluate material handling and feeding systems to improve operational efficiency. Safety & Compliance Ensure manufacturing processes comply with all applicable health, safety, and environmental requirements. Perform risk assessments and implement workplace safety improvements. Supplier & Procurement Support Prepare and issue Requests for Quotation (RFQs) to suppliers. Review technical and commercial proposals and support supplier selection activities. Support purchase order processing in accordance with procurement procedures. Documentation Management Manage receipt and validation of supplier documentation, including maintenance manuals, spare parts lists, reliability reports, installation drawings, and preventive maintenance plans. Track document completion and resolve outstanding issues with equipment suppliers before project closure. Qualifications Education Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Production Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline. Experience 3 to 5 years of manufacturing engineering experience within automotive production environments. Experience in engine and/or transmission assembly operations is preferred. Technical Skills Strong knowledge of engine and transmission assembly processes. Experience with manufacturing equipment, tooling, and automation systems. Proficiency in Auto CAD, CATIA, or equivalent CAD software. Understanding of: PFMEA Control Plans GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing) Lean Manufacturing Six Sigma methodologies Capacity planning and line balancing Professional Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Effective communication and presentation skills. Ability to work successfully in cross-functional teams. Experience supporting new product launches and manufacturing projects.

title: Cloud Architect
jobDescription:
Job Title: Cloud-Native Security & AI Architect (GCP / Zero Trust) Location: Hybrid — Dearborn, MI or Fully Remote (US based) Team: Ford Credit Enterprise Architecture About the

ROLE:
Ford Credit is accelerating its transition to a Zero-Trust security model on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and maturing their enterprise cloud security patterns. They are seeking a Cloud-Native Security & AI Architect to guide on-prem workload migrations into a secure, well-architected GCP environment, while also shaping their approach to safe and effective AI enablement (with a focus on agentic patterns in the SDLC). This role will help establish practical reference architectures, answering various “How do I do X securely?” questions from internal teams, driving clarity where standards are still emerging. What Success Looks Like (6–12 Months): Documented, adopted reference architectures and patterns for Zero Trust on GCP. Reduced critical security gaps across migrated workloads; measurable maturity lift (e.g., from 1/5 toward 3/5). Repeatable Apigee patterns established; known gaps documented with remediation backlog and owners. Teams self-serve with “How to do X securely?” guides; faster decision cycles and fewer escalations. Safe, pragmatic AI enablement patterns integrated into SDLC with clear guardrails and logging. Established security governance frameworks and stage-gates with both automation and human-in-the-loop processes. Tools & Ecosystem: GCP (IAM, Workload Identity, VPC, SCC, Cloud Armor, Secret Manager, Logging/Monitoring, GKE/Cloud Run, Build/Artifact), Apigee, Git Hub, JIRA, Confluence, Vault (as applicable), Terraform (nice to have). Zero-Trust Cloud Security Architecture (GCP) – primary focus Define and mature security architecture patterns and reference architectures for cloud-native workloads on GCP. Provide day-to-day guidance to application teams migrating from legacy environments to a new Zero-Trust GCP segment. Conduct gap analyses and recommend remediations to raise security maturity. Translate Ford’s Information Security Policies (ISP) into actionable architecture guidance and guardrails. Establish “golden paths” for securing RPC endpoints, service-to-service auth, workload identity, runtime security, and logging. Design and document secure patterns for hybrid connectivity, ensuring safe data exchange and identity federation between on-premise data centers (including mainframe environments) and GCP. Develop a holistic security strategy for critical third-party Saa S applications, focusing on identity integration (SSO), data governance, and unified visibility. Partner with threat modeling, networking, and data architecture teams to ensure holistic, risk-balanced designs. API & Apigee Security Enablement Define patterns for securing APIs and RPC endpoints with Apigee (auth N/Z, token flows, rate limiting, telemetry). Identify platform gaps; collaborate with Ford’s Apigee owner (EPEO) to drive improvements and reusable examples. AI Architecture (Agentic SDLC) – secondary focus Evaluate AI-enabled solutions for safety and security: “Is this secure? Is it safe? Are we allowed to do this?” Define secure agent patterns for SDLC use cases (e.g., agents drafting JIRAs, triaging issues). Apply AI safety best practices (prompt injection defenses, tool/API misuse prevention, data leakage controls). Design human-in-the-loop, decision traceability, and auditable logging for AI-assisted decision flows. Process & Enablement Create and maintain clear, consumable architecture documentation and standards from multiple sources. Mentor teams; answer questions rapidly; help the org balance speed with security in a zero-trust context. Contribute to a pragmatic roadmap to improve security maturity across the portfolio. Minimum Qualifications 10+ years of IT experience with 7+ years in cloud architecture/engineering with 4+ years focused on cloud security (enterprise scale). Deep hands-on experience with GCP services relevant to security: IAM & Workload Identity, VPC/SCC/Cloud Armor, Secrets Manager, Cloud Logging/Monitoring, GKE/Cloud Run, Artifact/Build, Pub/Sub, Apigee. Proven experience designing or maturing Zero-Trust architectures (Beyond Corp principles; identity-centric access). Strong understanding of OAuth/OIDC, service-to-service auth, token flows, and API security patterns. Experience designing security for hybrid architectures that connect modern cloud platforms with traditional enterprise data centers through GCP Interconnect, including mainframe systems. Experience with Saa S security frameworks and tools, such as Cloud Access Security Brokers (CASB), Saa S Security Posture Management (SSPM), and advanced data loss prevention (DLP) strategies. Integrate security seamlessly into the CI/CD pipeline (Dev Sec Ops), ensuring automated guardrails and infrastructure-as-code (Ia C) scanning are part of the 'golden path.' Experience producing reference architectures, standards, and “golden paths” for engineering teams. Good knowledge of security. Hands-on use of AI tools to improve productivity (e.g., coding, analysis, documentation). Excellent communication and stakeholder enablement skills. Preferred Qualifications GCP security certifications (e.g., Professional Cloud Security Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect). Experience with Apigee at enterprise scale (API gateways, policies, auth patterns, observability). Familiarity with LLM/agent attack vectors (prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool abuse, data exfiltration) and mitigations aligned to industry frameworks – OWASP for LLM, NIST AI RMF etc. Exposure to spec-driven development and content-distributed architectures. Understanding of regulated environment and associated compliance frameworks – PCI-DSS, SOC2, CCPA, GDPR and auditable human-in-the loop decisioning. Comfortable navigating ambiguity and building standards in-flight during large-scale migrations.
